hypothesis: The v1 stable-position +48 LMR reward may offset the benefit of protecting genuinely unstable positions. Preserve the cross-depth memory but make it one-sided so stable positions fall back exactly to the promoted FAYE-0008-v2 policy.

feature.name: Per-Position Cross-Depth Stability Memory - Unstable Only

design_guards: Retain the promoted FAYE-0008-v2 uncertainty controller unchanged
Stable positions receive no additional LMR reward
Only repeatedly unstable exact positions get a conservative LMR correction
No NMP, ProbCut, TT-cutoff, razoring, or futility-policy changes
No heap allocation in the node hot path
Reset stability memory once per UCI go

primary_strength_protocol.opponent: official-stockfish/Stockfish master fetched at run start

promotion_rule: Do not promote on point estimate alone. Compare against the promoted FAYE-0008-v2 reference and FAYE-0009-v1 under the recorded Stockfish SHA; promote only if evidence meaningfully supports a stronger engine.
